name: checkout

info.notes:
checkout has been installed into the demo-shop namespace.

This is a synthetic release record created by the kubeNimbus sandbox script.
No chart was ever rendered and nothing was installed by Helm.

Get the application URL:
  kubectl -n demo-shop port-forward svc/shop-web 8080:80
  open http://127.0.0.1:8080

metadata.name: checkout
metadata.description: Sandbox chart used to exercise kubeNimbus's read-only Helm release browser.

manifest:
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: checkout
  namespace: demo-shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: http
      name: http
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout
  namespace: demo-shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout
spec:
  replicas: __REPLICAS__
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          image: "nginx:1.27-alpine"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 24Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
